name: decode-uri-component
description: Vendored CommonJS copy of decode-uri-component 0.5.0, the release that fixes GHSA-vcc3-ghjq-m6fr. Upstream 0.5.0 is ESM-only, but query-string@7 (used by expo-router) require()s it, so package.json overrides it with this copy. Drop it once expo-router ships a fixed query-string.
